description.value: Nero Belgian Waffle Bar is an independent, family-owned restaurant started in 2012 by Belgian immigrants Jan and Eilnaz, known for authentic Brussels and Liège waffles. The original Robson Street location is small but full of character, serving both sweet and savoury waffles along with coffee and their popular mini Liège waffles. A cashless restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating and no reservations, it makes a convenient stop on a busy downtown cycling route.
